subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be a LINE-owned opt-in buffer, a broader shared media-aware inbound debounce contract, or documented as intentionally unsupported for heuristic channels?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds new user-visible buffering behavior and likely a config surface, and the repository policy keeps channel behavior plugin-owned unless maintainers choose to expand the shared contract.

options.title: LINE-owned opt-in buffer
options.body: Add a LINE plugin setting for same-account/conversation/sender media batching, keep shared text debounce unchanged, and validate reply-token fallback plus docs.

options.title: Shared media-aware debounce contract
options.body: Expand the shared inbound debounce/plugin SDK contract so several channels can batch media, accepting a broader compatibility and test surface.

options.title: Document as unsupported
options.body: Leave heuristic media batching disabled for channels without grouping metadata and document that media/attachments dispatch immediately.

recommendation.title: LINE-owned opt-in buffer
recommendation.body: Add a LINE plugin setting for same-account/conversation/sender media batching, keep shared text debounce unchanged, and validate reply-token fallback plus docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining actionable gap is in LINE plugin handling and config, where this handle has the strongest recent file history.
